Each conflict's primary_axis_of_disagreement is derived by a weighted keyword rule over nature_of_conflict text, not measured; the axis DISTRIBUTION is provisional and is to be corrected during section writing. Primary-section assignment, treatment mode and DOIs come from the records directly.
carried_evidence_limits: Search coverage is Europe PMC-dominant; PubMed E-utilities/CrossRef/bioRxiv/OpenAlex passes largely not run.
snowball_rounds=0 and saturation_criterion=null per scope, so no citation chasing or saturation stopping was performed.
Fulltext share varies by cluster (cluster_07 77/77 to cluster_08 22/87); low-share clusters are pre-2000 closed-access literature and no publisher API keys exist in this environment.
Contradiction sweeps were capped per query (typically first 50 records), so disconfirming coverage is top-relevance sample, not exhaustive.
cluster_09 replication ceiling is met by a single enabling label whose two corroborating sources are one peer-reviewed paper and one bioRxiv preprint, endpoint-matched but not model-identical.
